verdict.rationale: Polar documents fast, self-serve paths to taking card payments. These include no-code Checkout Links you configure once and share anywhere, embedded checkout, a free Starter plan with public pricing, and claims of "6 lines of code" and setup "in minutes" from an existing store. As Merchant of Record it charges customers itself, so Stripe does not need to be available in your country. Nothing in the evidence shows how long account onboarding, identity verification or merchant approval takes before live payments are enabled, so the within-a-day claim is implied rather than demonstrated. Missing for 10: documented onboarding/KYC/approval timeline to go live, explicit time-to-first-live-payment evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of same-day activation.
